question: Umbuzo
defaultDirections: Khetha impendulo ocabanga ukuthi iphendula umbuzo. Uma usuqedile, cindezela u-{checkAnswer}. Uzothola impendulo ekhombisa ukuthi impendulo yakho iqondile yini nokuthi uqhubeka kanjani.
relatedContentDescription: Lokhu kudala indawo egoqiwe yokuqukethwe okuhlobene nalo mbuzo futhi kuhlala kubonisiwe
hintDescription: Lokhu kuboniswa uma umsebenzisi engayiphendulanga kahle
evidenceDescription: Lokhu kuboniswa uma umsebenzisi eyiphendula kahle
sortingDirections: Beka izinto ngokulandelana okufanele ngokuchofoza imicibisholo ephezulu nephansi noma ngokuhudula nokuwisa. Uma ukholwa ukuthi zisezilandelaneni ezifanele, hlola impendulo yakho ngokukhetha u-{checkAnswer}. Uzothola impendulo ngezansi lapha ekhombisa ukuthi impendulo yakho iqondile yini.
